Print a gtstats variance object

Source: R/print_methods.R
print.gt_variance.Rd

Print publication-ready variance diagnostics. Group-level standard deviations and variances remain in $summary; variable-level ratios and explanatory text remain available in $diagnostics.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'gt_variance'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

x

A gt_variance object.

...

Further arguments passed to methods.

Value

The input object, invisibly.

Examples

x <- assess_variance(mtcars, vars = c(mpg, wt), by = am)
print(x)
